title: Zesty Grassy Algerian Stilton Cheese Flatbread
description: A quick and flavorful Algerian-inspired dish featuring Stilton cheese, confit tomato, and fresh herbs, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the flatbread into 1-inch strips and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the flatbread and sprinkle with minced garlic, if using.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and top each piece with a spoonful of confit tomato.
Sprinkle the crumbled Stilton cheese over the tomato.
Return the flatbread to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley and mint.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the flatbread warm, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
